That order lives outside xtraCHEF: For that distributor, the lines come from their guide, not from your invoices, and the order will not show in xtraCHEF's order log. The invoice still comes in as usual, so your food cost stays complete.

Check the invoice against what you sent: When the invoice for that delivery lands in xtraCHEF, set it beside your confirmation and order number. If an item, an amount or a price differs, you have the order number to raise it with your rep.
One distributor, one place to order: Pick xtraCHEF or our app for each distributor, never both. Once you speak orders to a distributor, do not also schedule a recurring xtraCHEF order to them.

@graph.name: Do I need an xtraCHEF alternative to order with my voice?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. xtraCHEF covers the paperwork side, from invoices to dish costs and inventory, and it can already email a vendor an order. When a distributor of yours is set up with us, say that order into your phone and let xtraCHEF carry on with the rest.

@graph.name: Is VoiceOrder Solutions better than xtraCHEF?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not for reading invoices, costing recipes, approving bills or syncing your accounting, because we do none of those. Our job is narrower: an order spoken to your distributor, with you reading each line before it leaves. If ordering is why you went looking for an xtraCHEF alternative, that job, next to xtraCHEF, may be enough.

@graph.name: Do VoiceOrder Solutions and xtraCHEF connect?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. They are not linked, nothing is shared between them, and each one has its own support. Anything you speak into our app goes to your distributor and never appears in xtraCHEF.

@graph.name: Can I use it with all my suppliers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only with distributors who provide VoiceOrder Solutions. xtraCHEF can order from any vendor at all, and we cannot. Stick with xtraCHEF for all the others, and check whether your other vendors are set up with us.

@graph.name: What if the app hears an amount wrong?

acceptedAnswer.text: You see each line before it is sent, so you fix it there: swap the item, change the amount or remove it. That review is the safeguard, but a quick look can still miss a mistake. Also, an order you phone in or leave on voicemail gets no order number from us; only orders sent in the app do.

@graph.name: How do I get set up, and what does it cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Through your distributor: they open your account and put your products in the app. If they don't offer it, or you are unsure, contact us and we will put you in touch with someone who can help. Most kitchens are sending their first order the same day. As for cost, that is a question for the distributor who gives you the app; we do not publish a price. xtraCHEF's price per location is published on its support site.

@graph.name: xtraCHEF can send my weekly order on a schedule. Why speak it?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most vendors, keep the schedule. With a distributor that gives you our app, you speak from their guide, and every line shows your account's price rather than whatever the previous invoice said. You go over the lines before sending, so a busy week or a quiet one gets the amounts it needs.
